name: SimplePivot
summary: SimplePivot is an Expert Advisor that calculates classical pivot point levels (Support/Resistance) based on the previous period's High, Low, and Close prices, and enters trades when price breaks through these pivot levels. It uses pivot-based support and resistance zones as entry signals with predefined take-profit targets at the next pivot level. The EA systematically trades breakouts from pivot levels with fixed lot sizing.
summary_zh: SimplePivot是一个基于经典支点计算的EA，根据前一周期的高点、低点和收盘价计算支撑/阻力位，并在价格突破这些支点水平时入场交易。它使用支点支撑和阻力区域作为入场信号，并在下一个支点水平设置止盈目标。该EA以固定手数系统性交易支点突破。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是经典支点计算方法，通过前一日的最高价、最低价和收盘价计算出中心支点以及S1/S2/S3和R1/R2/R3支撑阻力位。入场条件为价格突破支点支撑或阻力位时开仓，即突破阻力位做多，跌破支撑位做空。出场条件采用在下一个支点水平设置止盈的方式，例如突破R1后以R2为止盈目标。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面缺乏止损设置，仅依赖支点水平的反向突破来控制风险，这是一个较大的隐患。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但风险控制不够完善。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the classic pivot point calculation method, computing the central pivot along with S1/S2/S3 support and R1/R2/R3 resistance levels from the previous period's High, Low, and Close prices. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks through pivot support or resistance levels — going long on resistance breakout and going short on support breakdown. Exit conditions use the next pivot level as take-profit targets, for example targeting R2 after breaking R1. Position sizing employs a fixed lot approach without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management is notably deficient as there is no explicit stop-loss mechanism, relying instead on the opposite pivot level breakout for risk control, which presents a significant vulnerability. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and simple, but risk management is inadequately implemented.

parameters.description: 用于计算支点的基础时间周期

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和验证
支点是经典且被广泛使用的技术分析方法，具有市场心理支撑
多级别支撑阻力位提供了结构化的交易框架，入场和出场目标明确
pros_en: Strategy logic is clear and simple, easy to understand and verify
Pivot points are a classic and widely-used technical analysis method with market psychology backing
Multiple support/resistance levels provide a structured trading framework with clear entry and exit targets
cons: 缺乏明确的止损机制，风险控制严重不足
固定手数不做动态调整，未考虑账户资金比例
支点突破在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损
cons_en: Lack of explicit stop-loss mechanism, risk control is severely inadequate
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment ignores account equity proportion
Pivot breakouts generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to repeated losses
improvements: 添加基于ATR或支点水平的动态止损机制
引入资金管理模块，根据账户风险比例动态计算手数
增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向）以减少震荡市中的虚假突破信号
improvements_en: Add a dynamic stop-loss mechanism based on ATR or pivot levels
Introduce a money management module to calculate lot size dynamically based on account risk percentage
Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., moving average direction) to reduce false breakout signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 没有止损设置，单笔交易可能承受远超预期的亏损
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔亏损过大而爆仓
震荡行情中支点突破频繁失败，可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: No stop-loss set, a single trade may incur far greater loss than expected
Fixed lot size ignores account size, small accounts may blow up from a single excessive loss
Pivot breakouts frequently fail in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses

The EA systematically trades breakouts from pivot levels with fixed lot sizing.
